THE PROJECT

Revenue Grid

Introduction

Revenue Grid needed to make a complex, data-heavy sales platform easy to understand at a glance. We created explainer videos that broke down how the platform captures activity data, guides reps through their next best move, and turns pipeline data into actionable insights, giving sales teams and leaders a clear, digestible way to see the product’s value.
